propositions: docs/releasing.md incorrectly describes the pypi environment's required-reviewers rule as 'the second human approval on every publish' when it is actually a single configured reviewer (the release identity) with self-review permitted and admin bypass enabled

The runbook instructs operators to 'approve the pypi deployment when prompted' suggesting an interactive UI checkpoint, but approvals are granted non-interactively via the pending-deployments REST API

The approval mechanism controls identity and ref-based access to the publish job and its OIDC token, not content review — content review authority comes from Gerrit review of main branch, which the doc already states correctly

The non-interactive approval recipe requires a POST request body with environment_ids typed as a JSON integer array, not string-typed field flags, and must be preceded by a GET read to discover the environment id
.github/workflows/release.yml line 294 contains the same incorrect 'second human gate' framing in a comment and contradicts the corrected runbook documentation
